subject: math
topicName: Geometry - Lesson 9: Mixed Similarity and Special Triangle Problems
description: Solve mixed similarity and special right triangle problems by combining proportions with 45-45-90 and 30-60-90 ratios.
learningObjectives: Recognize when a problem needs both triangle similarity and a special right triangle ratio
Use 45-45-90 side ratios to find unknown lengths after setting a scale factor
Use 30-60-90 side ratios to connect short leg, long leg, and hypotenuse
Write proportion chains that keep corresponding sides in the same order
Choose the correct theorem or ratio from diagram markings
Write complete solutions that include setup, calculation, units, and reasoning
prerequisites: Identify corresponding sides in similar triangles
Know that 45-45-90 triangles have side ratio 1:1:sqrt(2)
Know that 30-60-90 triangles have side ratio 1:sqrt(3):2
Read triangle markings and angle labels from diagrams
